justification: Both show repeated human-related forms in a horizontal row and something like a series of upright stroke elements (the crew strokes on the boat versus the standing bearded attendants with staffs), but that is about the limit of the correspondence. A is dominated by a large schematic outline boat with spiralling prow and stick-like crew strokes, while B shows naturalistic, modelled full-length robed figures with elaborate beards, headgear and held weapons, sharing neither the boat motif nor any specific posture or attribute.
